preconditions.description: The number of provinces P is between 1 and 15 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 600 for N in [int(stdin.split()[i]) for i in range(0, len(stdin.split()), 3)])
preconditions.description: Each province has a number of columns N between 1 and 600 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == N for P in range(P) for N, S1, S2 in [stdin.split()[i:i+3] for i in range(0, len(stdin.split()), 3)] for S in [S1, S2])
preconditions.description: Each row string S in a province has length N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S) for P in range(P) for N, S1, S2 in [stdin.split()[i:i+3] for i in range(0, len(stdin.split()), 3)] for S in [S1, S2])
preconditions.description: Each character in the row strings S is a lowercase letter.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of provinces P.
Each output value is a positive integer representing the number of distinct strings.
